rows.label: Formula
rows.text:
∫xⁿ dx = x^{n+1}/(n+1)+C
∫u dv = uv − ∫v du
∫_a^b f = F(b) − F(a)

rows.text: ∫xⁿ dx = x^{n+1}/(n+1) + C (n ≠ −1); ∫dx/x = ln|x| + C. Indefinite = family of antiderivatives.  ·  Integration by parts: ∫u dv = uv − ∫v du (LIATE choice). Substitution: let t = g(x), adjust dx.

rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: Trick 1: Zero order: [A] = [A]0 − kt, half-life t½ = [A]0/2k (depends on initial concentration); first order: ln[A]0/[A] = kt, t½ = 0.693/k (independent of concentration) — the half-life contrast is THE exam discriminator.  ·  Trick 2: Identify order from data: successive half-lives equal → first order; doubling time with concentration halves → zero order.
